search_intent: A Sammamish homeowner planning a backyard shed, studio or detached home office wants to know when a building permit is required, which setbacks, height and coverage limits apply, how critical areas, trees and drainage affect siting, who issues the electrical permit, when a studio becomes an ADU, which foundation fits, and how to vet the builder.
local_angles: SMC 16.20.200: exempt IRC tool/storage sheds, playhouses, not vehicle storage, <=200 sf floor area, <=12 ft grade plane to roof top; exemption void in critical areas and standard shoreline setbacks
Handout No. 240: likely need a permit; permit for any electric or plumbing work; setbacks table; arterial front 30 ft; side/rear reducible to 5 ft by recorded neighbor agreement (SMC 21.04.030.C.19)
SDC 21.04.030: accessory structure setbacks by zone; height 35/60 ft; hardscape coverage max 30/40/50/75/85/85%; DADU 5 ft side/rear, 24 ft height, only stand-alone
Sammamish ADU page: up to two ADUs; detached max 1,000 sf; complete residences with kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, entrance; ADUs exempt from FAR
L&I city electrical list includes Sammamish (801 228th Ave SE); SMC 16.20.197 electrical permit required; L&I: contractor buys own permit
Trees: significant conifer >8 in DBH, deciduous >12 in DBH; all trees in critical areas/buffers need permit; SDC 21.03.060 removal caps
SDC 21.03.050 drainage review at 2,000 sf impervious or 7,000 sf land disturbance; Sammamish Addendum lower thresholds (landslide 200 sf, Pine/Beaver Lake 500 sf, Tamarack/Inglewood any)
Construction hours SMC 16.05.030: M-F 7am-8pm, Sat 9am-6pm, no Sundays/holidays
notes: Box-authored fallback brief. PPG only as Board #1 -> https://pacificprogroup.com/.
